answer: By the orchard of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The jetty lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the haven is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
